_about: Ratchet for DR-0733 and DR-0795. Measured over every registered course: `lessons` is the catalog's size, `all` is how many carry their OWN prompts in all three directions when the whole module is pooled (talkTogetherCoverage), and `everyBand` is how many are whole in EVERY place a reader actually reads - the lesson prose and each band present (everyBandCoverage). Every number may only rise. Every lesson added on or after 2026-10-01 must carry all three in every band it ships.
